content.title: Aubrey Plaza Is Pregnant with Her First Baby (Exclusive)
content.text: PEOPLE confirms the actress is expecting a child with her partner Chris Abbott Published on April 7, 2026 08:42PM EDT Credit : Mat Hayward/Getty NEED TO KNOW Aubrey Plaza is pregnant and expecting her first child with partner Chris AbbottThe couple previously worked together on an off-Broadway play and the 2020 film Black BearPlaza attended Paris Fashion Week last month Aubrey Plaza is pregnant! A source tells PEOPLE that Plaza is expecting her first child with her partner, Chris Abbott, and is due this fall. “It was a beautiful surprise after an emotional year,” the source says, adding that “they feel very blessed.” A rep for Plaza confirmed the news to PEOPLE. Plaza, 41, and Abbott, 40, have previously collaborated on the Off-Broadway revival of Danny and the Deep Blue Sea and the 2020 film Black Bear. He's currently starring on Broadway in the revival of Arthur Miller's Death of a Salesman opposite Nathan Lane and Laurie Metcalf. At the Loewe show, the star wore an oversized leather jacket paired with a red sweater and booties.
